CustomField.formula:
/*This formula will display the IM_Partner_Overview__c field from Account record if it has no parent account specified, otherwise it will traverse the Account hierarchy all the way to the top (up to 5 levels) and will display the IM_Partner_Overview__c field from the top-most parent */
IF( LEN(ParentId)==0 , (IM_Partner_Overview__c), IF(LEN( Parent.ParentId )==0, (Parent.IM_Partner_Overview__c), IF(LEN( Parent.Parent.ParentId )==0, (Parent.Parent.IM_Partner_Overview__c), IF(LEN( Parent.Parent.Parent.ParentId )==0, (Parent.Parent.Parent.IM_Partner_Overview__c), IF(LEN( Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.ParentId )==0, (Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.IM_Partner_Overview__c), IF(LEN( Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.ParentId )==0, (Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.IM_Partner_Overview__c), "Error: Only up to 6 hierarchy levels are supported"))))))
CustomField.label: Partner Overview (Formula)
